You are not india why concern of it, there is a reason old practitioner went to the mountain, it makes it easer to let go, but ofcourse its better to let go in an area that makes it hard en constantly enticies you because once you do manage to let go of an attachment you just remain immune, diffence between a compact sand  a rock, one was a sand that had to be compacted repeatedly that it eventually morphed and become solid while another has yet to face storm hard enough to crack it through yet. Imagine when i say "show me your soul" will you take out sand neatly arrange en clean en nice en peaceful, or take out a rock badly formed and defomed battle wary en torn but oozing not peace just unyielding, anyway both are fine, it only means one will have to compact themselves if the next obstable require unyielding strengh while the other will have to learn to soften themselves if the next obstacle requires one to be malleable, only different is we born mostly as loose  sand so the rock already knows how be loose when needed it be little easier to switch back
